notes: Run with the formdeck engine and window open (./formdeck) and the formdeck MCP server connected. Fixture paths are examples; any equivalent files work. Expected behaviours are observable in the tool calls and the final deck.

evals.name: meeting-notes-and-screenshots-to-product-update
evals.prompt: Turn these meeting notes and 4 screenshots into a 10-slide product update in the Aurora template: ~/work/q3/standup-notes.md and the PNGs in ~/work/q3/shots. It's for the leadership sync on Thursday.
expected_behavior: Calls get_context, then one ingest with both paths as absolute paths and a brief, without reading the files directly
Calls draft_spec with the intake id, template aurora and slides 10, then rewrites the script before build_deck
The built deck has 10 slides, titles phrased as claims, and every screenshot placed by asset id on an image layout
Runs render_slides and lint_deck after building, sets fit contain on cropped screenshots, and ends with 0 lint errors
Sets handoff ready on the slides it built (no review verdict) and sends a summary naming the deck id, template and open questions

evals.name: fix-overflowing-slides
evals.prompt: slides 4 and 7 are overflowing in my deck, can you fix them
expected_behavior: Uses get_context to find the deck the person is looking at, then get_deck detail text for slides 4 and 7
Runs lint_deck to confirm the overflow measurement before editing
Cuts words with set_text or splits with update_slide plus add_slides rather than enlarging boxes first
Re-renders only slides 4 and 7 (and any new slide) and re-runs lint_deck until 0 errors
Does not rebuild the whole deck with build_deck

evals.name: make-it-an-investor-pitch
evals.prompt: This reads like an internal update. Make it more like an investor pitch, we're raising a seed round next month.
expected_behavior: Reads the current deck outline with get_deck instead of exporting or reading JSON for every slide
Re-maps the story to the pitch arc (problem, solution, traction, market, model, team, ask) using only facts already in the deck or intake
Uses update_slide per slide, or build_deck with a new deck id stated to the person when most slides change
Adds an ask slide only with figures the person provided, or asks for the raise amount instead of inventing one
Re-renders, lints and leaves changed slides in review

evals.name: export-to-pdf
evals.prompt: export to pdf and put it on my desktop
expected_behavior: Finds the deck with get_context
Calls export_deck with format pdf and an absolute path under the home Desktop folder
Reports the exact path and size returned by the tool
If the window is closed, relays that pdf export needs the window and offers pptx as an alternative instead of failing silently

evals.name: board-update-from-pdf-and-spreadsheet
evals.prompt: Build our Q3 board update from /Users/ana/board/q3-financials.xlsx and /Users/ana/board/ops-report.pdf. 12 slides, something formal.
expected_behavior: Chooses a Business or Report template via list_templates and states the choice in one line
Uses get_source on a table id to get chart JSON and builds at least one chart slide from it
Uses stats or bigNumber layouts for headline figures with units and comparisons
Includes decisions or asks for the board, and every number traces to the intake
Ends with lint 0 errors, review status set, summary sent

evals.name: apply-company-template
evals.prompt: Use our brand template instead, it's at ~/Brand/Northwind-2026.potx
expected_behavior: Calls open_file with asTemplate true and the absolute path
Compares the recognised semantic layouts with the 21 and mentions any missing ones
Calls apply_template on the current deck with the new template id
Renders every slide afterwards and fixes collisions with the brand masters

evals.name: answer-review-comments
evals.prompt: I left some comments on the deck, go through them
expected_behavior: Calls review with no status and comments action list to see slides marked changes and open comments
Fixes each commented slide with the smallest tool
Replies to each addressed comment saying what changed, then resolves it; leaves unaddressed questions open
Sets fixed slides back to review and summarises the changes

evals.name: undo-agent-changes
evals.prompt: undo what you just did to the title slide, I liked it before
expected_behavior: Uses undo with scope step when only the last change should go, or explains that a turn undo would revert more
Does not attempt to undo the person's own edits; fixes forward if undo refuses
Confirms the restored state with get_deck or render_slides

evals.name: pdf-editing-goes-to-formpdf
evals.prompt: Merge contract-a.pdf and contract-b.pdf in ~/Legal into one file, then split out pages 1-3 of the merged one as a summary
expected_behavior: Says that formdeck no longer edits PDFs and that PDF editing lives in formpdf (github.com/nodemode-ai/formpdf)
Does not call ingest, build_deck or any other formdeck tool for this request
Does not build a deck

evals.name: pdf-handout-to-slides-keep-look
evals.prompt: I only have the PDF of last year's keynote, I need it as slides I can present from formdeck, it should look exactly the same
expected_behavior: Explains that Insert > Slides from PDF Pages in the formdeck window adds one slide per page with the page picture and its text in the speaker notes, which keeps the look
Offers ingest and build_deck for an editable rebuild in a template instead
Does not claim a pdf tool exists

evals.name: training-deck-from-docx-with-sections
evals.prompt: Make a 20 slide onboarding training for new support staff from ~/Support/handbook.docx, Education style, with sections
expected_behavior: Uses the training arc with an agenda and section slides carrying section and number directives
Uses process layouts for procedures and comparison for do and do not
Every content slide has speaker notes with the source id
Agenda items match the section names exactly

evals.name: headless-no-window
evals.prompt: build a 6 slide deck from ~/notes/launch.md in the Launchpad template
expected_behavior: Notices from get_context that no window is connected and tells the person once that rendering and pdf export need ./formdeck
Still ingests, drafts, builds and runs static lint_deck
Does not claim the slides were visually checked; the summary says they were not rendered

evals.name: restyle-darker-brand-colour
evals.prompt: can you make the deck dark and use our orange #F26B1D for accents
expected_behavior: Picks a dark template via list_templates query dark and applies it with apply_template
Calls set_theme with accent1 #F26B1D
Re-renders and runs lint_deck, reporting any contrast warning the new colour causes

evals.name: adjacent-code-change-should-route-away
evals.prompt: add a new MCP tool to formdeck that duplicates a deck
expected_behavior: Does not drive the deck-building loop or call build_deck
Routes to formdeck-skillset (developer work on the codebase)
